# Captured from the test device: `cat /proc/net/arp`
# REDACTED: the two br-lan client MACs were replaced with the locally-administered
# 02:00:00:00:00:0x series so the repository carries no real hardware identifier.
# The wired client (192.168.1.2) and the Wi-Fi client (192.168.1.151) are both on
# br-lan in 192.168.1.0/24, which is the point: nothing but the access-point
# association separates them.
